Interface ServerPayload

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
ErrorServerPayload, GameServerPayload, LobbyServerPayload, PreLobbyServerPayload
All Known Implementing Classes:
AuthenticationResultPayload, ErrorPayload, GamePayload, LobbyListPayload, LobbyUpdatePayload
public interface ServerPayload extends Serializable
Marker interface for all data payloads sent from the server to the client.

Implementing classes represent status reports, list queries, error details, or full game state snapshots broadcasted by the server.
